image_description: A high-angle view of a steep, sunlit cliff face composed of stratified rock layers. The rock exhibits vertical weathering patterns and erosion channels. Green vegetation (trees and shrubs) grows on the lower ledges and base. At the bottom right, a body of water is visible with a small structure or boat near the shore. The lighting suggests late afternoon or early morning sunlight hitting the upper portion of the cliff.

The vertical streaks on the cliff face have a slight repetitive pattern and uniformity that feels somewhat artificial, though subtle.
